description: This SCSS file defines a mixin for responsive font sizing based on the RFS (Responsive Font Sizes) system. It includes configuration variables for font size, breakpoints, and scaling factors, as well as mixins for applying responsive font sizes in styles.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin that calculates and applies responsive font sizes based on provided font size, breakpoints, and scaling factors.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: Alias mixin that includes the rfs mixin for setting font size responsively.

methods.name: responsive-font-size
methods.description: Alias mixin that includes the rfs mixin for setting font size responsively.
